classify_openai_request: classify text input using OpenAI-compatible v1/classify API endpoint with model id2label mapping
build_classify_response: build a classification response with predicted labels, probabilities, and token usage from model embeddings
validate_classify_input: validate classify request input to ensure non-empty strings or non-negative integer token IDs
convert_to_internal_request: convert OpenAI ClassifyRequest to internal EmbeddingReqInput format for tokenizer manager
get_id2label_mapping: retrieve id2label mapping from model config or generate default LABEL_0, LABEL_1 mapping from num_labels
